purpose: Report a slight sign of a condition, usually an unwelcome one.
keywords: I feel a little tired today.
I have not been getting quite enough exercise lately.
I have felt a little under the weather since morning, so I will go to bed early.
restrictions: Often a temporary feeling or early symptom; not a strong established condition.
mistake: 気味 describes a slight state; がち describes a recurring tendency.

segments.role: Report a slight sign of a condition, usually an unwelcome one. Verb stem / noun + 気味
